description: Download the signed ZIP for a message id from list_invoices and save it to the downloads outbox (a name holding another file gets a number, never overwritten). The archive is checked first: it must open with every entry matching its checksum and hold the document with ANAF's seal (semnatura_*.xml), and the seal is checked against the document. Returns the path, bytes, sha256 and md5 of the archive, each entry's name, bytes and sha256, the seal's verdict, and what the invoice says.

message_id.description: The id field from list_invoices (digits), not requestId.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the downloads outbox (e.g. "2026-09"); empty means the outbox itself. A path outside it is refused.

test.description: Query ANAF's test environment instead of production.

name: download_invoice
title: Download a signed invoice archive
